description_en: Queries the destination rate limit events
description_zh: 查询目的限速事件列表
name: DescribeSlaEventList

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service Valid values:

- **cn**: Anti-DDoS Pro

- **cn-hongkong**: Anti-DDoS Premium
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
- **cn**：中国内地。
- **cn-hongkong**：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。

> 必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页包含的记录数量
parameters.name: page_size
